authorizationId.description: The authorization the money returns through.

attempts.description: Provider attempts so far (a FAILED refund is retried up to 5).

failureCode.description: The provider's failure code; present on a FAILED refund.

providerRefundId.description: The provider's refund id; present on a SUCCEEDED refund.

404.description: not-found (no such resource, or an identifier longer than 128 characters); resource-not-found for a path that carries a NUL character.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example over-refund.

500.description: internal-error (an unexpected failure; the detail never carries the internal message).
